title: Classic Honeypot for CF7
description: Ad-free GPL fork of the Honeypot for Contact Form 7 WordPress plugin, based on version 2.1.1.
status_text: Version 1.0.2, tested with WordPress 7.1.4 and Contact Form 7 6.2.4.1, is published on WordPress.org and GitHub. No work in progress; maintenance on demand.
